description: REEF3D::HYDRO catchment model only (R 100 1) on a synthetic mountain catchment (24 km x 16 km DEM of 200 m pixels, DIVEMesh W 10: 2 km cells, 3 elevation bands, glacier and zone rasters, outlet and two gauges): HBV with 300 mm initial snow from mid-March, hourly, two stations with lapse rates, Oudin PET, MAXBAS, kinematic wave. Gauges, budget and catchment means as text. Validated against an independent Python implementation in Dropbox HYDRO/validation/07_catchment_model.
covers: DIVEMesh catchment: depression filling, bands, glacier and zone rasters, gauges
forcing interpolation and lapse rates, Oudin PET
